thread:
sara-devops: Seeing a sharp spike in 502s from hosted inference in us-west2-az3, auth retries also up. Customers reporting timeouts and partial responses. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Incident created INC-175111 — triage channel: #incidents. Initial impact: hosted API 502/gateway errors in us-west2 (az3).
cs-liz: Customer ops pinging desks — several paying customers seeing failed requests and duplicate billing for retries, asking for ETA.
alex-runtime: Got logs, looks like a lot of upstream connection resets and repeated TCP retransmits. Sample error from api-gateway: `502 upstream read timeout`
jordan-net: Observed ECMP path instability — metrics show path flaps between provider A and provider B for az3 egress. Suspect path-tearing causing out-of-order packets and retransmits.
sara-devops: Can someone grab a quick traceroute and tcpdump from a failing host? Customer repro steps: call /v1/generate with large prompt -> token streaming stalls -> gateway 502 after ~12s.
alex-runtime: Running `traceroute -n 10.0.3.12` shows alternating next-hops, hops 4-6 changing between two ASes. Sending tcpdump now: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/az3-repro.pcap port 443 and host 1.2.3.4`
jordan-net: Confirmed BGP withdraws from provider; frequent ECMP rebalancing + unequal path latencies = packet reordering. That can break TLS session performance and cause upstream timeouts in our gateway.
ops-bot: Automated mitigation options: 1) Shift traffic to az2 fallback pool 2) Temporarily prefer single egress path in route policy 3) Increase gateway read timeout to 25s for canary customers.
cs-liz: Customers want quick mitigation, prefer a route change if that has lowest user impact. Any ETA for making a routing policy tweak?
alex-runtime: Can do a canary failover for a subset of routes to az2 now. We'll also enable short-term tcp reassembly tweaks on gateway (increase reassembly buffer). Rolling in 2 minutes.
sara-devops: Posting commands for repro capture if needed:
```
# from a failing host
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-large","prompt":"x"}'
# look for: 
# * Server HTTP/2 stream 1 -> 502, Upstream read timeout
```
jordan-net: Added temporary route policy to prefer Provider B (less jitter) for az3 egress. Monitoring.
ingest-bot: Alert: 95th p50 p95 latency for hosted-inference/us-west2/az3: p95 -> 2.8s -> 7.2s after flaps. 502 rate increased from 0.2% -> 3.6% in 5m.
alex-runtime: Canary to az2 seems to reduce 502s for 10% of traffic. Rolling to 50% while we validate. Not touching customer committed dedicated capacity.
cs-liz: Notifying affected customers of temporary failover and asking for impact confirmations.
sara-devops: For postmortem: need pcap, BGP adj logs from providers, and list of affected customers and routes. Added follow-up tasks to INC-175111.
jordan-net: Next steps: get provider engineering on a call, request stabilization (suppress ECMP rebalances), and then revert route preference once paths are stable.
alex-runtime: Saved tcpdump snippet to /var/persistent/pcaps/175111-az3.pcap and uploaded to S3. Sample tcpdump shows repeated dup ACKs and out-of-order segments.
cs-liz: Flag: billing team to review duplicate retry billing for customers who retried during incident window.
sara-devops: Thanks all. Keeping channel open for updates. :eyes:
ops-bot: Incident INC-175111 status -> mitigated (partial) at 1751112600; mitigation: route preference + gateway reassembly tweak. Monitoring until stable.
